summary: NetEase, Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC for May 2026, solely announcing a record date for its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders. The filing contains a brief announcement of the meeting record date and is signed by the CEO. There are no terms, transaction details, board recommendations, or advisors mentioned. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. The filing is a routine corporate governance notice, not a special situation.
